transcript.text: Last spring I was in Shanghai for work and I remember chatting with a coworker about how parking there can be such a headache.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Later on, I also heard about a weekend in Guangzhou where people were comparing what shows were on around town.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For that Shanghai trip, my colleague said they ended up using Xujiahui Grand Gateway Parking, starting at 2025-03-11 09:00, and they stayed parked for about 6 hours.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I still remember the car details they mentioned afterward—license plate was 川D78901, and the driver phone they used was 13845678901.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And in Guangzhou, a friend told me they’d already gotten a ticket for Cantonese Opera Classics—First Floor, just 1 ticket—under Luo Fei, and the contact number on it was 13899887766.
